stem: A partially clogged filter reduced irrigation output in part of a room, followed by rising root-zone EC in the same area. Which interpretation is strongest?
choices: The spatial and timing evidence supports investigating delivery-driven accumulation before blaming the nutrient formulation
High root-zone EC proves the source water changed
The filter event cannot affect root-zone conditions
The whole room should be flushed without verification
rationale: Documented delivery reduction followed by localized accumulation provides a plausible causal chain that should be verified before formulation changes.
